mission: Safe class for staging database connection failures (owner GO 2026-10-22, password-rotation recovery): since the Postgres password was rotated, staging-state and db-diagnostic report only 'database read/connection failed' while Railway's Data tab reads the same database. Report class, exception type and SQLSTATE so the cause is visible without echoing the driver message (host, user).

impacts.reason: DB_FAILURE_CLASSES and db_failure_class(error): class (auth, hba, no_database, timeout, refused, dns, tls, closed, too_many, unclassified, silent), exception type and a 5-character SQLSTATE; the database read failure message gains it. The driver text is matched in memory and dropped, as failure_class already does for CLI text.
The ops 'staging database connection failed' refusal gains the same class. Read-only path unchanged.
Each class from a realistic driver message carrying a host; the host never appears in the label; a malformed sqlstate is dropped.

routes: Staging Postgres read-only connection (unchanged; only the failure message changes)
impact.deployment_impact: Tooling only: no service, collector, fleet or schema change.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own docs/agent/missions/<name>.json; the messages return to the bare 'failed'.
recovery.trigger: A summary shows any host, user or password text.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: The next ops-readonly staging-state and db-diagnostic runs.
